card.line: Kadesh-barnea was a desert city on the southern edge of the Promised Land, where Israel refused to enter the land and was sent to wander for forty years.

moments.title: Told to take the land
moments.text: When Israel reached Kadesh-barnea, Moses said the LORD had placed the land before them. He told them to go up and take it and not to be afraid or discouraged.

moments.title: Twelve men sent to spy
moments.text: Moses sent men from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land, one from each tribe. They went to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land. Then they discouraged the Israelites from entering it.

moments.title: Israel rebels against God
moments.text: The LORD told Israel to go up and possess the land, but they rebelled. They neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.

moments.title: Forty years of wandering
moments.text: Because they did not follow Him wholeheartedly, the LORD swore that the men twenty or older who came out of Egypt would not see the land. Only Caleb and Joshua among them would enter it. Israel wandered until that generation was gone.

moments.title: Caleb sent from Kadesh-barnea
moments.text: Caleb was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land. He brought back an honest report. Moses promised him the land because he wholly followed the LORD.
